stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related pneumonitis in a patient receiving pembrolizumab for non-small cell lung cancer
title.zh: 非小细胞肺癌患者接受pembrolizumab后发生免疫检查点抑制剂相关性肺炎

summary.en: A client receiving pembrolizumab for NSCLC develops a new dry cough, exertional dyspnea, crackles, and progressive oxygen desaturation. The nurse must recognize an immune-related adverse event, prioritize oxygenation and ordered corticosteroid therapy, communicate within scope, and evaluate early response to treatment.
summary.zh: 一名因NSCLC接受pembrolizumab治疗的患者出现新发干咳、活动后气促、爆裂音和进行性血氧下降。护士必须识别免疫相关不良事件，优先处理氧合并执行corticosteroid医嘱，在职责范围内沟通，并评估早期治疗反应。

content.en: A 63-year-old woman with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer is receiving pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks as second-line therapy. She completed cycle 4 nine days ago. Prior carboplatin/pemetrexed was stopped for disease progression. History: remote 30-pack-year smoking history, well-controlled hypertension on amlodipine, mild osteoarthritis treated with acetaminophen. No autoimmune disease, no chest radiation, and no known drug allergies. Baseline SpO2 before therapy was 96% on room air with no oxygen requirement.
content.zh: 一名63岁女性患有IV期非小细胞肺癌，正在接受二线治疗：pembrolizumab 200 mg IV，每3周一次。她在9天前完成第4个周期。既往carboplatin/pemetrexed因疾病进展而停止。病史包括既往30包年吸烟史（已戒烟）、用amlodipine控制良好的高血压，以及用acetaminophen处理的轻度骨关节炎。无自身免疫病史、无胸部放疗史、无已知药物过敏。治疗前基线SpO2为室内空气96%，不需要吸氧。

content.en: The client reports a new dry cough for 4 days and feels more winded walking from the parking lot. She denies fever, hemoptysis, and chest pain. Vital signs: T 37.1 C, HR 92, BP 134/78, RR 20, SpO2 93% on room air. Lung sounds: faint bilateral inspiratory crackles at the bases; no wheezing, rhonchi, or stridor. No peripheral edema or JVD. Mucosa moist, capillary refill <2 seconds, bowel sounds present, skin warm and dry. She speaks in full sentences but pauses after longer phrases to breathe.
content.zh: 患者报告新发干咳4天，从停车场走来时比平时更气促。否认发热、咯血和胸痛。生命体征：T 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)，HR 92，BP 134/78，RR 20，室内空气SpO2 93%。肺部听诊：双侧肺底可闻及轻微吸气性爆裂音；无哮鸣音、干湿啰音或喘鸣。无外周水肿或颈静脉怒张。口腔黏膜湿润，毛细血管再充盈<2秒，肠鸣音存在，皮肤温暖干燥。她能说完整句子，但较长语句后会短暂停顿换气。

content.en: WBC 6.8 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, glucose 102 mg/dL, ALT 28 U/L, AST 31 U/L, TSH 2.4 mIU/L, CRP 18 mg/L (reference <5), LDH 240 U/L (reference 120-246). No baseline ABG is available; clinic protocol uses pulse oximetry monitoring.
content.zh: WBC 6.8 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血小板188 ×10³/µL，BUN 14 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，钠139 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，血糖102 mg/dL，ALT 28 U/L，AST 31 U/L，TSH 2.4 mIU/L，CRP 18 mg/L（参考值<5），LDH 240 U/L（参考值120-246）。无基线ABG；门诊方案使用脉搏血氧监测。

title.en: Stage 1: Clinic visit, 9 days after cycle 4
title.zh: 阶段1：第4周期后第9天门诊就诊

content.en: The client minimizes symptoms and asks whether she can take an antihistamine and return for the next infusion as scheduled. SpO2 is 93% on room air, down from the documented baseline of 96%. She has a new dry cough, exertional dyspnea, bilateral basilar crackles, and CRP 18 mg/L. The oncologist is in clinic and available; no imaging has been obtained yet.
content.zh: 患者淡化症状，并询问是否可以服用抗组胺药，然后按计划回来接受下一次输注。室内空气SpO2为93%，低于记录的基线96%。她有新发干咳、活动后气促、双侧肺底爆裂音，CRP 18 mg/L。肿瘤科医师在门诊可联系；尚未取得影像检查。

content.en: After nurse notification, the oncologist orders stat chest CT with contrast and ABG. CT: new bilateral ground-glass opacities, predominantly lower lobes; no pleural effusion, pulmonary embolism, or lymphangitic carcinomatosis. ABG on room air: pH 7.44, PaCO2 36 mmHg, PaO2 68 mmHg. Repeat vitals: T 37.2 C, HR 98, BP 130/82, RR 22, SpO2 91% on room air. The oncologist states findings are consistent with immune-related pneumonitis and orders: hold pembrolizumab, admit for observation, start supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 >=94%, initiate methylprednisolone per the facility irAE pneumonitis protocol, repeat pulse oximetry every 2 hours, and consult pulmonology.
content.zh: 护士通知医师后，肿瘤科医师开立急诊增强胸部CT和ABG。CT：新发双侧磨玻璃影，以下肺叶为主；无胸腔积液、肺栓塞或淋巴管性癌病。室内空气ABG：pH 7.44，PaCO2 36 mmHg，PaO2 68 mmHg。复测生命体征：T 37.2 C，HR 98，BP 130/82，RR 22，室内空气SpO2 91%。肿瘤科医师说明结果符合免疫相关性肺炎，并开立医嘱：暂停pembrolizumab，收入院观察，开始吸氧以维持SpO2 >=94%，按院内irAE肺炎方案给予methylprednisolone，每2小时复测脉搏血氧，并请肺科会诊。

content.en: The client is anxious and asks whether this means her cancer treatment is being stopped permanently.
content.zh: 患者感到焦虑，询问这是否意味着她的癌症治疗将被永久停止。

content.en: The client has received methylprednisolone per protocol and oxygen by nasal cannula at 3 L/min. Vitals: T 37.0 C, HR 86, BP 126/76, RR 18, SpO2 96% on 3 L nasal cannula. She reports the cough is about the same but she is not as short of breath. Crackles remain bilaterally but are similar to slightly less prominent. ABG on 3 L nasal cannula: pH 7.42, PaCO2 38 mmHg, PaO2 82 mmHg. CRP has decreased from 18 to 11 mg/L.
content.zh: 患者已按方案接受methylprednisolone，并通过鼻导管3 L/min吸氧。生命体征：T 37.0 C，HR 86，BP 126/76，RR 18，鼻导管3 L/min下SpO2 96%。她表示咳嗽差不多，但没有那么气促。双侧仍有爆裂音，但相似或略减轻。鼻导管3 L/min下ABG：pH 7.42，PaCO2 38 mmHg，PaO2 82 mmHg。CRP从18降至11 mg/L。

title.zh: 会诊建议和健康教育需求

content.en: Pulmonology recommends a slow corticosteroid taper over several weeks per facility protocol and says pembrolizumab should remain discontinued unless oncology documents a risk-benefit decision. The oncologist confirms the client will not receive the next pembrolizumab cycle and will be re-evaluated for alternative cancer-treatment planning after recovery. The nurse is asked to teach the client to report worsening dyspnea, new or increasing cough, fever, chest pain, or recurrence of the symptoms that prompted admission during the taper. The husband asks whether she should also stop her blood pressure medication.
content.zh: 肺科建议按院内方案在数周内缓慢减量 corticosteroid，并说明除非肿瘤科记录风险获益决定，否则pembrolizumab应继续停用。肿瘤科医师确认患者不会接受下一周期pembrolizumab，康复后将重新评估替代癌症治疗计划。护士需教育患者在减量期间如出现气促加重、新发或加重咳嗽、发热、胸痛，或入院时症状复发，应立即报告。丈夫询问她是否也应停用降压药。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that are clinically significant cues requiring further evaluation for immune-related pneumonitis.
stem.zh: 请标出提示需要进一步评估免疫相关性肺炎的临床重要线索。

segments.en: New dry cough began 4 days ago, 9 days after pembrolizumab cycle 4.
segments.zh: 第4周期pembrolizumab后9天出现新发干咳，已持续4天。

segments.en: Temperature is 98.8 °F (37.1 °C).
SpO2 is 93% on room air, down from baseline 96%.
segments.zh: 室内空气SpO2为93%，低于基线96%。

segments.en: Faint bilateral inspiratory crackles are heard at the lung bases.
segments.zh: 双侧肺底可闻及轻微吸气性爆裂音。

segments.en: She pauses briefly to breathe after longer phrases.
segments.zh: 较长语句后会短暂停顿换气。

segments.en: No peripheral edema or JVD is present.
segments.zh: 无外周水肿或颈静脉怒张。

segments.en: CRP is 18 mg/L with a reference value below 5 mg/L.
segments.zh: CRP为18 mg/L，参考值低于5 mg/L。

segments.en: Creatinine, ALT, AST, and TSH are within the listed reference context.
segments.zh: 肌酐、ALT、AST和TSH在所列参考背景内。

segments.en: Capillary refill is less than 2 seconds and oral mucosa is moist.
segments.zh: 毛细血管再充盈少于2秒，口腔黏膜湿润。

correct.en: The new dry cough after recent pembrolizumab, falling SpO2 from baseline, bilateral crackles, exertional dyspnea, and elevated CRP form a lower-respiratory inflammatory cue cluster. Afebrile status and normal perfusion or unrelated labs do not make the respiratory change safe to dismiss.
correct.zh: 近期pembrolizumab后出现新发干咳、SpO2较基线下降、双侧爆裂音、活动后气促和CRP升高，构成下呼吸道炎症线索组合。无发热以及灌注正常或无关实验室结果，不能说明这些呼吸变化可以忽略。

byChoice.en: New cough shortly after an immune checkpoint inhibitor cycle is a key respiratory cue.
byChoice.zh: 免疫检查点抑制剂周期后不久出现新发咳嗽，是关键呼吸线索。

byChoice.en: An afebrile temperature does not require highlighting as a positive pneumonitis cue; immune-related pneumonitis may be afebrile.
byChoice.zh: 无发热本身不是需要标出的肺炎阳性线索；免疫相关性肺炎可不发热。

byChoice.en: A fall from the documented baseline SpO2 is objective evidence of worsening oxygenation.
byChoice.zh: SpO2较记录基线下降，是氧合变差的客观证据。

byChoice.en: Bilateral basilar crackles indicate lower-respiratory involvement rather than isolated allergy symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 双侧肺底爆裂音提示下呼吸道受累，而不是单纯过敏症状。

byChoice.en: Pausing to breathe after longer phrases is a functional sign of exertional dyspnea.
byChoice.zh: 较长语句后需要停顿换气，是活动后气促的功能性表现。

byChoice.en: Absence of edema or JVD helps argue against fluid overload but is not a positive pneumonitis cue.
byChoice.zh: 无水肿或颈静脉怒张有助于排除容量负荷过多，但不是肺炎阳性线索。

byChoice.en: CRP elevation supports an inflammatory process when interpreted with the respiratory findings.
byChoice.zh: 结合呼吸系统表现，CRP升高支持炎症过程。

byChoice.en: Normal renal, hepatic, and thyroid results do not explain the acute respiratory cue cluster.
byChoice.zh: 肾、肝、甲状腺相关结果正常，不能解释急性呼吸线索组合。

byChoice.en: Normal capillary refill and moist mucosa are reassuring perfusion/hydration findings, not pneumonitis cues.
byChoice.zh: 毛细血管再充盈正常和黏膜湿润是灌注/水合情况较好的表现，不是肺炎线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient suggests a benign explanation, compare it with objective changes from baseline and organ-specific findings.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者提出良性解释时，要把它与客观基线变化和器官特异性体征进行比较。

glossary.defZh: 增强抗肿瘤免疫反应的药物，也可能引发免疫相关不良反应。
肺组织的炎症，可导致咳嗽、气促、氧合下降和影像异常。
炎症标志物；升高需结合临床表现解释。

stem.en: At Stage 1, analyze the cue cluster and the patient's self-diagnosis.
stem.zh: 在阶段1，请分析线索组合和患者的自我判断。

clozeStem.en: The findings best support {{d1}} rather than {{d2}} because the pattern includes lower-respiratory findings, a measurable oxygenation decline, inflammatory elevation, and recent immunotherapy exposure.
clozeStem.zh: 这些表现最支持 {{d1}}，而不是 {{d2}}，因为该模式包括下呼吸道体征、可测量的氧合下降、炎症指标升高，以及近期免疫治疗暴露。

options.en: immune-related pneumonitis
options.zh: 免疫相关性肺炎

options.en: isolated osteoarthritis flare
options.zh: 单纯骨关节炎加重

options.en: uncomplicated allergic rhinitis
options.zh: 单纯过敏性鼻炎

options.en: seasonal allergies
options.zh: 季节性过敏

options.en: acute kidney injury
options.zh: 急性肾损伤

options.en: immune-related thyroiditis
options.zh: 免疫相关性甲状腺炎

correct.en: The recent pembrolizumab exposure plus new cough, crackles, desaturation, dyspnea, and CRP elevation fit an immune-mediated lower-respiratory process. Seasonal allergies would more commonly produce sneezing, rhinorrhea, itchy or watery eyes, and upper-airway symptoms rather than crackles and falling oxygen saturation.
correct.zh: 近期pembrolizumab暴露，加上新发咳嗽、爆裂音、血氧下降、气促和CRP升高，符合免疫介导的下呼吸道过程。季节性过敏通常表现为打喷嚏、流涕、眼痒或流泪等上气道症状，而不是爆裂音和血氧下降。

byChoice.en: The first blank requires the most likely clinical explanation for the lower-respiratory cue cluster after pembrolizumab exposure.
byChoice.zh: 第一个空格要求判断pembrolizumab暴露后下呼吸道线索组合最可能的临床解释。

byChoice.en: The second blank identifies the benign explanation that is inadequate because it does not account for crackles, desaturation, or inflammatory lung findings.
byChoice.zh: 第二个空格指出那个不充分的良性解释，因为它不能解释爆裂音、血氧下降或肺部炎症表现。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not anchor on the patient's explanation when objective respiratory findings point to a higher-risk adverse effect.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当客观呼吸系统发现提示较高风险不良反应时，不要锚定在患者自己的解释上。

glossary.defZh: 胸部影像上肺组织密度增加但仍可见血管和支气管结构的表现。
SpO2或PaO2下降，提示氧合变差。
以流涕、喷嚏、鼻痒和眼部症状为主的上气道过敏反应。

stem.en: At Stage 2, CT findings are consistent with immune-related pneumonitis, PaO2 is 68 mmHg on room air, and SpO2 has fallen to 91%. Which ordered intervention is the nurse's immediate priority?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，CT结果符合免疫相关性肺炎，室内空气PaO2为68 mmHg，SpO2降至91%。护士应优先执行哪项已开立的医嘱？

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen and titrate to the ordered SpO2 target.
options.zh: 给予补充氧气，并调整至医嘱规定的SpO2目标。

options.en: Begin discharge teaching about future cancer-treatment options.
options.zh: 开始进行未来癌症治疗选择的出院教育。

options.en: Prepare the next pembrolizumab infusion so treatment is not delayed.
options.zh: 准备下一次pembrolizumab输注，以免治疗延误。

options.en: Call pulmonology before starting oxygen or corticosteroids.
options.zh: 在开始吸氧或 corticosteroid 前先致电肺科。

correct.en: The active oxygenation deficit is the immediate physiologic threat. Applying oxygen directly addresses breathing while the nurse then proceeds with corticosteroids, monitoring, and consultation.
correct.zh: 当前氧合不足是最直接的生理威胁。给予氧气直接处理呼吸问题，随后护士再继续执行corticosteroid、监测和会诊相关工作。

byChoice.en: Pembrolizumab is ordered to be held; continuing it during active pneumonitis could worsen the immune-mediated lung injury.
byChoice.zh: 医嘱要求暂停pembrolizumab；在活动性肺炎期间继续使用可能加重免疫介导的肺损伤。

byChoice.en: The consult is important, but delaying existing oxygen and steroid orders for a callback is unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 会诊很重要，但为了等待回电而延误已开立的吸氧和 steroid 医嘱是不安全的。

byChoice.en: Correct. SpO2 91% and PaO2 68 mmHg indicate worsening oxygenation, so oxygen comes first by ABC priority.
byChoice.zh: 正确。SpO2 91%和PaO2 68 mmHg提示氧合恶化，因此按ABC优先原则应先给氧。

byChoice.en: Teaching is needed, but it does not take priority over an acute oxygenation problem.
byChoice.zh: 健康教育是需要的，但不能优先于急性氧合问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several orders are appropriate, choose the one that treats the immediate ABC threat first.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多项医嘱都合适时，先选择处理最直接ABC威胁的措施。

glossary.defZh: ABG中反映血液氧合水平的指标。
通过鼻导管、面罩等方式提高吸入氧浓度。
护理优先级判断中用于识别立即生命威胁的原则。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the client asks whether her cancer treatment is being stopped permanently. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，患者询问她的癌症治疗是否会被永久停止。哪些护理措施合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Promise that pembrolizumab will restart after the cough improves.
options.zh: 承诺咳嗽改善后会重新开始pembrolizumab。

options.en: Tell her the oncology team will discuss the long-term treatment plan after she is stabilized.
options.zh: 告诉她肿瘤团队会在她稳定后讨论长期治疗计划。

options.en: Initiate methylprednisolone as ordered per the facility protocol.
options.zh: 按院内方案和医嘱开始给予methylprednisolone。

options.en: Verify oxygen delivery is maintaining the ordered SpO2 target and arrange every-2-hour pulse oximetry.
options.zh: 确认给氧能维持医嘱要求的SpO2目标，并安排每2小时脉搏血氧监测。

options.en: Explain that pembrolizumab is being held now because of serious lung inflammation.
options.zh: 解释pembrolizumab目前因严重肺部炎症而暂停。

options.en: Independently tell her the drug is permanently discontinued and that all cancer treatment is over.
options.zh: 独立告诉她该药已永久停用，而且所有癌症治疗都结束了。

correct.en: The nurse can give truthful, scope-appropriate information: the drug is held now, oncology will decide and explain the long-term plan, and urgent ordered treatment must continue. Promising restart or independently declaring all treatment over is outside nursing scope and inaccurate.
correct.zh: 护士可以提供真实且符合职责范围的信息：该药目前暂停，长期计划由肿瘤科决定并解释，同时必须继续执行紧急医嘱治疗。承诺重启或独立宣布所有治疗结束都超出护理职责且不准确。

byChoice.en: Appropriate. Long-term cancer-treatment planning is led by oncology after stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 合适。长期癌症治疗计划应由肿瘤科在患者稳定后主导。

byChoice.en: Inappropriate. It oversteps scope and falsely implies there are no alternative cancer-treatment plans.
byChoice.zh: 不合适。这超出职责范围，并错误暗示没有其他癌症治疗计划。

byChoice.en: Inappropriate. Rechallenge cannot be promised during active pneumonitis and depends on oncology risk-benefit decisions.
byChoice.zh: 不合适。活动性肺炎期间不能承诺重新使用，是否再挑战取决于肿瘤科风险获益决定。

byChoice.en: Appropriate. It directly explains the immediate reason for holding the drug without making a provider-level final decision.
byChoice.zh: 合适。它直接解释暂停药物的当前原因，同时没有替医师做最终决定。

byChoice.en: Appropriate. Corticosteroids are ordered to treat the immune-mediated inflammatory process and should not be delayed by the conversation.
byChoice.zh: 合适。corticosteroid已开立用于治疗免疫介导炎症过程，不应因谈话而延误。

byChoice.en: Appropriate. Oxygenation and ordered surveillance are part of the immediate safety plan.
byChoice.zh: 合适。维持氧合和按医嘱监测是当前安全计划的一部分。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate what the nurse can truthfully explain from provider-level decisions, while still carrying out urgent safety interventions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分护士可以如实解释的内容和医师层级决定，同时继续执行紧急安全干预。

glossary.defZh: 不良反应恢复后，在严密评估下重新使用可疑药物。
免疫治疗引起的、由免疫反应介导的不良事件。
护士可独立执行、解释或决定的专业边界。

stem.en: At Stage 2, place the ordered nursing actions in the best sequence.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，请将已开立的护理措施按最佳顺序排列。

options.en: Establish every-2-hour pulse oximetry monitoring and document the baseline on-oxygen reading.
options.zh: 建立每2小时脉搏血氧监测，并记录吸氧后的基线读数。

options.en: Notify or coordinate with pulmonology for co-management after bedside stabilization is underway.
options.zh: 在床边稳定措施已开始后，通知或协调肺科共同管理。

options.en: Initiate methylprednisolone as ordered, verifying dose, route, and rate against the protocol order.
options.zh: 按医嘱开始methylprednisolone，并根据方案医嘱核对剂量、途径和速度。

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen and confirm SpO2 is moving toward the >=94% target.
options.zh: 给予补充氧气，并确认SpO2正接近>=94%的目标。

correct.en: This is a clinically real sequence: first correct the immediate oxygenation deficit, then begin the anti-inflammatory corticosteroid treatment, then set up surveillance to detect improvement or deterioration, and then coordinate the consult once urgent bedside actions are underway.
correct.zh: 这是临床上真实的顺序：先纠正最直接的氧合不足，再开始抗炎的corticosteroid治疗，然后建立监测以发现改善或恶化，最后在紧急床边措施已启动后协调会诊。

byChoice.en: Pulmonology consultation is important but should not delay oxygen or ordered corticosteroids.
byChoice.zh: 肺科会诊重要，但不应延误吸氧或已开立的corticosteroid。

byChoice.en: Monitoring is established after initial treatment actions so the team can trend response and detect deterioration.
byChoice.zh: 初步治疗措施后建立监测，以便团队观察趋势并发现恶化。

byChoice.en: Oxygen is first because it treats the immediate breathing threat.
byChoice.zh: 吸氧排第一，因为它处理最直接的呼吸威胁。

byChoice.en: Steroid treatment follows promptly after oxygenation is supported because it treats the immune-mediated cause.
byChoice.zh: 在氧合得到支持后应迅速给予steroid，因为它治疗免疫介导的病因。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use ABCs to start the sequence, then ask which action treats the cause, which action monitors response, and which action coordinates ongoing care.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 排序时先用ABC确定第一步，再判断哪项治疗病因、哪项监测反应、哪项协调后续护理。

glossary.defZh: 一种全身性corticosteroid，用于抑制炎症和免疫反应。
无创连续或间断测量血氧饱和度的方法。
请求专科团队参与评估和共同管理。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding when evaluating the response to treatment.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，评估治疗反应时，请对每项发现进行分类。

rows.en: SpO2 is 96% on 3 L nasal cannula after being 91% on room air.
rows.zh: 此前室内空气SpO2为91%，现在鼻导管3 L下SpO2为96%。

rows.en: PaO2 improved from 68 mmHg on room air to 82 mmHg on 3 L nasal cannula.
rows.zh: PaO2从室内空气68 mmHg改善为鼻导管3 L下82 mmHg。

rows.en: CRP decreased from 18 mg/L to 11 mg/L.
Heart rate and respiratory rate decreased to HR 86 and RR 18.
rows.zh: 心率和呼吸频率下降至HR 86、RR 18。

rows.en: The client says she is not as short of breath.
rows.zh: 患者表示没有那么气促。

rows.en: Bilateral crackles are still present but similar to slightly less prominent.
rows.zh: 双侧仍有爆裂音，但相似或略减轻。

columns.en: Does not by itself indicate treatment failure
columns.zh: 单独来看不表示治疗失败

correct.en: The client is improving because multiple trends are moving in the right direction: oxygenation, vital signs, inflammatory marker, and subjective dyspnea. Persistent crackles at 36 hours do not outweigh the broader improvement because inflammatory lung findings can resolve slowly.
correct.zh: 患者正在改善，因为多项趋势都朝正确方向变化：氧合、生命体征、炎症指标和主观气促。36小时仍有爆裂音不能推翻整体改善，因为炎症性肺部体征可能需要更长时间才会消退。

byChoice.en: A higher SpO2 with oxygen support compared with the prior room-air desaturation supports improved gas exchange, while still requiring continued ordered oxygen.
byChoice.zh: 与此前室内空气低氧相比，吸氧支持下SpO2升高支持气体交换改善，但仍需继续按医嘱吸氧。

byChoice.en: The PaO2 trend is improved, but it must be interpreted in context because the later value is on supplemental oxygen.
byChoice.zh: PaO2趋势改善，但需结合背景解释，因为后一次数值是在吸氧状态下取得。

byChoice.en: Falling CRP supports a decreasing inflammatory response.
byChoice.zh: CRP下降支持炎症反应减轻。

byChoice.en: Lower heart rate and respiratory rate suggest less physiologic stress and ventilatory demand.
byChoice.zh: 心率和呼吸频率下降提示生理应激和通气需求降低。

byChoice.en: The client's report of less dyspnea is a meaningful outcome cue when paired with objective improvement.
byChoice.zh: 患者主诉气促减轻，与客观改善相结合时是有意义的疗效线索。

byChoice.en: Persistent but stable or slightly improved crackles are expected during early recovery and do not alone indicate treatment failure.
byChoice.zh: 恢复早期爆裂音仍存在但稳定或略减轻是可预期的，单独来看不代表治疗失败。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trends across several systems, not by one persistent abnormal finding.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估疗效时看多个系统的趋势，不要只依据一个持续异常体征。

glossary.defZh: 治疗后症状、体征或实验室指标是否改善。
同一指标随时间变化的方向，比单次数值更能说明病情走向。
常用低流量吸氧装置。

correct.en: The case arc centers on recognizing an immune checkpoint inhibitor-related pulmonary toxicity before it is dismissed as allergies. The significant cues are new dry cough, lower-respiratory crackles, dyspnea, SpO2 decline from baseline, elevated CRP, and later CT/ABG confirmation. Nursing priorities are to notify oncology, hold the checkpoint inhibitor per orders, correct oxygenation first, initiate ordered corticosteroids per protocol, monitor trends, communicate within scope about cancer-treatment decisions, and teach immediate reporting of worsening dyspnea, cough, fever, chest pain, or recurrence during taper.
correct.zh: 本病例的主线是在症状被误认为过敏之前识别免疫检查点抑制剂相关肺毒性。重要线索包括新发干咳、下呼吸道爆裂音、气促、SpO2较基线下降、CRP升高，以及后续CT/ABG确认。护理优先事项包括通知肿瘤科、按医嘱暂停检查点抑制剂、先纠正氧合、按方案执行corticosteroid医嘱、监测趋势、在职责范围内沟通癌症治疗决定，并教育患者在减量期间如气促、咳嗽、发热、胸痛加重或症状复发应立即报告。

testTakingStrategy.en: In oncology immunotherapy cases, treat new organ-specific symptoms as potential immune-related adverse events until assessed; then prioritize immediate physiologic threats before education or consultation tasks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在肿瘤免疫治疗病例中，应将新出现的器官特异性症状视为潜在免疫相关不良事件，直到完成评估；随后先处理直接生理威胁，再处理教育或会诊任务。

glossary.defZh: PD-1免疫检查点抑制剂，用于多种癌症治疗。
免疫治疗引发的免疫介导性组织炎症或器官损伤。
为减少复发和不良反应，按方案逐步降低corticosteroid剂量。
血液携带氧气的状态，可通过SpO2和PaO2评估。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.zh: 化疗低谷期中性粒细胞减少性发热

summary.en: A 58-year-old woman with stage IIIB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is on day 10 of cycle 2 R-CHOP and is in the expected count nadir window. She was admitted two days ago for poor oral intake and dehydration. A triple-lumen PICC is patent. Standing orders require blood cultures and immediate oncology notification for a single oral temperature ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) or temperature ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) sustained over one hour.
summary.zh: 一名 58 岁女性，患 IIIB 期弥漫大 B 细胞淋巴瘤，正在第 2 个 R-CHOP 周期第 10 天，处于预期血细胞计数低谷期。她两天前因进食差和脱水入院。三腔 PICC 通畅。常规医嘱要求：单次口温 ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) 或体温 ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) 持续 1 小时时，采集血培养并立即通知肿瘤科。

content.en: Diagnosis: stage IIIB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Treatment: cycle 2 day 10 R-CHOP. Oncology note: expected count nadir window. Admission reason: poor oral intake and dehydration. Allergies: none known. Line: triple-lumen PICC, flushed and patent. Baseline admission vitals: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 78, BP 118/72, RR 14, SpO₂ 98% room air. Standing order: for any single oral temperature ≥ 101 °F (38.3 °C) or oral temperature ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) sustained over one hour, obtain blood cultures (two peripheral sets and one PICC lumen per local order) and notify oncology immediately.
content.zh: 诊断：IIIB 期弥漫大 B 细胞淋巴瘤。治疗：R-CHOP 第 2 周期第 10 天。肿瘤科记录：处于预期血细胞计数低谷期。入院原因：进食差和脱水。过敏史：无已知药物过敏。管路：三腔 PICC，已冲管且通畅。入院基线生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 78，BP 118/72，RR 14，室内空气 SpO₂ 98%。常规医嘱：任何单次口温 ≥ 101 °F (38.3 °C)或口温 ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C)持续 1 小时，采集血培养（按本机构医嘱采两组外周血和一个 PICC 管腔样本）并立即通知肿瘤科。

title.zh: 初始评估和 1420 实验室结果

content.en: 1415: client reports sudden cold, shaky feeling; visible rigors. Vitals: T 102 °F (38.9 °C) oral, HR 104, BP 108/68, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% room air. Skin warm/flushed over trunk; fingertips cool and slightly mottled; capillary refill 3 seconds. Mucous membranes dry with a small intact oral mucositis area on left buccal mucosa. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, non-tender, normoactive bowel sounds. PICC site without erythema, drainage, or tenderness; dressing clean/dry/intact. Alert and oriented; feels awful. Urine output prior 4 hours: 180 mL. No perianal complaints; no rectal assessment performed. 1420 CBC: WBC 0.6 ×10³/µL, ANC 180/µL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, platelets 112 ×10³/µL. BMP: Na 137, K 3.9, Cl 101, CO₂ 24, BUN 18, creatinine 0.9, glucose 118. Lactate 1.4 mmol/L. UA clear, no WBCs or nitrites.
content.zh: 1415：患者报告突然觉得冷、发抖；可见寒战。生命体征：口温 102 °F (38.9 °C)，HR 104，BP 108/68，RR 20，室内空气 SpO₂ 96%。躯干皮肤温暖潮红；指尖发凉、轻度花斑；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。黏膜干燥，左侧颊黏膜有一小处完整口腔黏膜炎。双肺清晰。腹部柔软、无压痛，肠鸣音正常。PICC 部位无红斑、渗液或压痛；敷料清洁、干燥、完整。神志清楚，定向力完整，自述感觉很糟。前 4 小时尿量 180 mL。无肛周不适，未进行直肠评估。1420 CBC：WBC 0.6 ×10³/µL，ANC 180/µL，Hgb 9.8 g/dL，血小板 112 ×10³/µL。BMP：Na 137，K 3.9，Cl 101，CO₂ 24，BUN 18，肌酐 0.9，血糖 118。乳酸 1.4 mmol/L。尿检清亮，无 WBC、无亚硝酸盐。

title.en: Stage 1: 1415 to 1500, fever recognized and first antibiotic started
title.zh: 第 1 阶段：1415 至 1500，识别发热并开始首次抗生素

content.en: The nurse identifies fever and rigors, obtains vital signs and labs, and draws blood cultures from two peripheral sites and one PICC lumen at 1425 per standing order. Oncology is notified at 1430. The oncologist confirms neutropenic fever and orders empiric broad-spectrum IV antibiotics to start as soon as possible, with the first dose within one hour of documented fever. Orders also include chest X-ray, repeat lactate in four hours, and normal saline at 125 mL/hr. Antibiotic infusion begins via the PICC at 1445, 15 minutes after cultures. Neutropenic precautions sign: no fresh flowers/plants; follow facility low-microbial/food-safety protocol; hand hygiene before entry; no ill visitors. No rectal temperatures, rectal medications, or unnecessary invasive procedures. Chest X-ray at 1455: no infiltrate or effusion.
content.zh: 护士识别发热和寒战，获取生命体征和实验室检查，并于 1425 按常规医嘱从两个外周部位和一个 PICC 管腔采集血培养。1430 通知肿瘤科。肿瘤科医生确认中性粒细胞减少性发热，并医嘱尽快开始经验性广谱 IV 抗生素，首次剂量须在记录发热后 1 小时内给予。医嘱还包括胸片、4 小时后复查乳酸、0.9% 氯化钠 125 mL/hr。1445 经 PICC 开始抗生素输注，距离培养采集 15 分钟。门口张贴中性粒细胞减少防护标识：禁止鲜花/植物；遵循机构低微生物/食品安全方案；进入前手卫生；患病访客不得探视。不得直肠测温、直肠给药或做不必要的侵入性操作。1455 胸片：无浸润或积液。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：1500 至 1800，血流动力学恶化

content.en: 1600: rigors have stopped and the client feels slightly better. 1730: restless and lightheaded when sitting up. 1745 vitals: T 102.9 °F (39.4 °C), HR 118, BP 92/58, RR 24, SpO₂ 94% room air. Capillary refill 4 seconds. Alert but slower to respond and fatigued. Urine output over the past 4 hours: 60 mL. 1800 lactate: 3.2 mmol/L, up from 1.4. The nurse repositions the client supine, initiates an isotonic crystalloid bolus per sepsis protocol with reassessment, applies O₂ 2 L/min nasal cannula, notifies oncology and rapid response, and redraws blood cultures. The oncologist broadens antibiotics. Oral mucositis and PICC site are unchanged; lungs remain clear.
content.zh: 1600：寒战停止，患者感觉稍好。1730：烦躁，坐起时头晕。1745 生命体征：T 102.9 °F (39.4 °C)，HR 118，BP 92/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO₂ 94%。毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。仍清醒但回答变慢、疲乏。过去 4 小时尿量 60 mL。1800 乳酸：3.2 mmol/L，高于 1.4。护士协助患者平卧，按脓毒症方案开始等渗晶体液快速补液并复评，给予鼻导管 O₂ 2 L/min，通知肿瘤科和快速反应团队，并重新采集血培养。肿瘤科医生扩大抗生素覆盖。口腔黏膜炎和 PICC 部位无变化；双肺仍清晰。

title.en: Stage 3: 1800 to 1030 next morning, response and discharge-readiness teaching
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：1800 至次日 1030，治疗反应和出院准备教育

content.en: After the bolus and broadened antibiotics: 1930 vitals T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), HR 106, BP 100/64, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. More alert and conversational. Urine output 1800-2000: 90 mL. Lactate at 2100: 2.0 mmol/L. Capillary refill 3 seconds. 2200 vitals T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), HR 96, BP 106/68, RR 18, SpO₂ 97% on 2 L; urine output 2000-2200: 110 mL. Initial blood cultures pending. At 1030 next morning, microbiology reports a preliminary Gram-positive organism in the PICC lumen bottle at 20 hours, with speciation and sensitivities to follow. Oncology states the client will remain inpatient on IV antibiotics until afebrile for at least 48 hours and ANC shows early recovery. The nurse begins discharge-readiness teaching for future cycles.
content.zh: 补液和扩大抗生素后：1930 生命体征 T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，HR 106，BP 100/64，RR 20，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO₂ 96%。患者更清醒并能交谈。1800-2000 尿量 90 mL。2100 乳酸：2.0 mmol/L。毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。2200 生命体征 T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，HR 96，BP 106/68，RR 18，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO₂ 97%；2000-2200 尿量 110 mL。初始血培养待出。次日 1030，微生物实验室报告 20 小时培养的 PICC 管腔瓶初步见革兰阳性菌，菌种和药敏待出。肿瘤科说明患者需继续住院接受 IV 抗生素，直到至少 48 小时无发热且 ANC 出现早期恢复。护士开始针对未来疗程进行出院准备教育。

stem.en: Highlight the Stage 1 findings that are significant cues of a time-critical neutropenic fever emergency.
stem.zh: 请标出第 1 阶段提示中性粒细胞减少性发热为时间紧迫急症的重要线索。

segments.en: At 1415 the client has visible rigors and says she feels suddenly cold and shaky.
segments.zh: 1415，患者出现明显寒战，并说自己突然觉得很冷、发抖。

segments.en: Oral temperature is 102.0 °F (38.9 °C).
HR is 104/min.
segments.zh: 心率为 104 次/分。

segments.en: BP is 108/68 mm Hg.
segments.zh: 血压为 108/68 mm Hg。

segments.en: Fingertips are cool and slightly mottled with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 指尖发凉、轻度花斑，毛细血管再充盈时间为 3 秒。

segments.en: Lung sounds are clear bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。

segments.en: The PICC insertion site is clean, dry, intact, and non-tender.
segments.zh: PICC 置管部位清洁、干燥、完整，且无压痛。

segments.en: The left buccal mucosa has a small intact area of oral mucositis.
segments.zh: 左侧颊黏膜有一小处完整的口腔黏膜炎。

segments.en: WBC is 0.6 ×10³/µL with ANC 180/µL during the expected chemotherapy nadir.
segments.zh: 预期化疗低谷期内，WBC 为 0.6 ×10³/µL，ANC 为 180/µL。

segments.en: Lactate is 1.4 mmol/L.
segments.zh: 乳酸为 1.4 mmol/L。

correct.en: The fever exceeds the standing single-reading threshold, and rigors, tachycardia, severe neutropenia during the nadir, and early peripheral vasoconstriction make this a time-critical emergency. Clear lungs, a normal-appearing PICC site, and normal lactate do not rule out serious infection in a neutropenic client.
correct.zh: 体温超过医嘱中单次读数的发热阈值；寒战、心动过速、低谷期严重中性粒细胞减少以及早期外周血管收缩共同提示这是时间紧迫的急症。双肺清晰、PICC 部位外观正常和乳酸正常，并不能排除中性粒细胞减少患者的严重感染。

byChoice.en: Rigors are a systemic inflammatory cue and are not a routine chemotherapy complaint in this context.
byChoice.zh: 寒战是全身炎症反应线索，在此情境下不能当作普通化疗不适处理。

byChoice.en: A single oral temperature of 102 °F (38.9 °C) exceeds the standing fever threshold and requires immediate action.
byChoice.zh: 单次口温 102 °F (38.9 °C) 已超过医嘱发热阈值，需要立即处理。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia reinforces the systemic response and increases concern for early sepsis progression.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速加强了全身反应的判断，并增加早期脓毒症进展的担忧。

byChoice.en: This blood pressure is lower than baseline but is not the key emergency cue at the first assessment; it becomes more concerning when it later drops to 92/58.
byChoice.zh: 该血压低于基线，但在首次评估时并非最关键的急症线索；之后降至 92/58 时才更提示恶化。

byChoice.en: Cool mottled fingertips and delayed refill suggest early peripheral vasoconstriction and impaired perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 指尖发凉、花斑和再充盈延迟提示早期外周血管收缩及灌注受损。

byChoice.en: Clear lung sounds are reassuring but do not reduce urgency because neutropenic clients may lack localizing inflammatory signs.
byChoice.zh: 双肺清晰是相对安心的发现，但中性粒细胞减少患者可能缺乏局部炎症体征，因此不能降低紧急程度。

byChoice.en: A clean, non-tender PICC site does not rule out bloodstream infection because erythema or drainage may be absent in severe neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: PICC 部位清洁且无压痛不能排除血流感染，因为严重中性粒细胞减少时可没有红肿或渗液。

byChoice.en: Oral mucositis is a possible portal of entry and should be monitored, but this small intact lesion is not itself the acute change that defines the emergency.
byChoice.zh: 口腔黏膜炎可能是感染入口，需要观察；但这个小且完整的病灶本身不是定义急症的急性变化。

byChoice.en: ANC 180/µL confirms severe neutropenia during the expected nadir, so fever can progress rapidly to sepsis.
byChoice.zh: ANC 180/µL 证实预期低谷期内严重中性粒细胞减少，因此发热可迅速进展为脓毒症。

byChoice.en: A lactate of 1.4 mmol/L is not elevated at this moment; later lactate rise is what signals worsening perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 此时乳酸 1.4 mmol/L 未升高；之后乳酸上升才提示灌注恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: In oncology nadir questions, treat fever plus severe neutropenia as the danger signal even when the source exam looks normal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到肿瘤治疗低谷期题目时，即使感染来源检查看似正常，也要把发热加严重中性粒细胞减少视为危险信号。

glossary.defZh: 中性粒细胞数量过低，导致患者难以抵抗细菌和真菌感染。
用于判断感染防御能力的中性粒细胞绝对数量。
强烈发抖，常提示菌血症或全身炎症反应。
化疗后血细胞计数预计降到最低的时间段。

stem.en: Complete the reasoning chain for the Stage 1 cultures-and-antibiotics requirement.
stem.zh: 请完成第 1 阶段关于培养和抗生素要求的临床推理链。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should obtain ordered blood cultures {{d1}}, then start empiric IV antibiotics {{d2}}, because {{d3}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应 {{d1}} 取得医嘱要求的血培养，然后 {{d2}} 开始经验性 IV 抗生素，因为 {{d3}}。

options.en: after the antibiotic infusion is complete
options.zh: 在抗生素输注完成后

options.en: only if a local source of infection is found
options.zh: 只有找到局部感染来源时

options.en: before the first antibiotic dose
options.zh: 在首次抗生素给药前

options.en: within the ordered one-hour window
options.zh: 在医嘱规定的 1 小时窗口内

options.en: after culture results identify the organism
options.zh: 等培养结果确定病原体后

options.en: after the fever has persisted for another hour
options.zh: 等发热再持续 1 小时后

options.en: neutropenic clients usually produce obvious localizing infection signs
options.zh: 中性粒细胞减少患者通常会出现明显局部感染体征

options.en: antibiotics are unsafe until all imaging is completed
options.zh: 所有影像检查完成前使用抗生素不安全

options.en: cultures preserve diagnostic yield while rapid empiric therapy limits progression
options.zh: 培养可保留诊断价值，同时快速经验性治疗可限制病情进展

correct.en: Cultures before antibiotics preserve the chance of identifying the organism, but this should take minutes, not delay treatment. The provider order pairs rapid cultures with prompt empiric antibiotics because the severely neutropenic client has little innate immune defense.
correct.zh: 抗生素前采集培养可保留识别病原体的机会，但这应在几分钟内完成，不能延误治疗。医嘱将快速采集培养与及时经验性抗生素配对，是因为严重中性粒细胞减少患者几乎没有足够的先天免疫防御。

byChoice.en: Blood cultures are drawn before antibiotic exposure so the culture result is interpretable; drawing them afterward risks false-negative results.
byChoice.zh: 血培养应在接触抗生素前采集，结果才更可解释；之后采集会增加假阴性风险。

byChoice.en: The order specifies prompt first-dose administration; waiting for speciation or another fever check would misuse the time-critical pathway.
byChoice.zh: 医嘱要求及时给首次剂量；等待菌种鉴定或再次测温会错误使用这一时间紧迫流程。

byChoice.en: The two requirements are complementary: cultures support targeted therapy later, and empiric antibiotics protect the client now.
byChoice.zh: 这两个要求相辅相成：培养为后续靶向治疗提供依据，经验性抗生素则立即保护患者。

testTakingStrategy.en: When two urgent actions seem to compete, ask whether one is a brief prerequisite that protects later care without delaying the lifesaving intervention.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当两个紧急措施看似冲突时，判断其中一个是否是短时间即可完成、能保护后续治疗价值且不延误救命措施的前置步骤。

glossary.defZh: 在病原体尚未确定前，根据最可能病原和病情严重程度立即给予的抗生素。
用于检测血液中细菌或真菌并指导后续抗感染治疗的检查。
检查结果显示阴性，但实际上存在疾病或病原体。

stem.en: At Stage 2, place the nurse's immediate priority actions in the order they should be ensured. Some bedside tasks may overlap, but the sequence should reflect the dominant priorities.
stem.zh: 在第 2 阶段，请按护士应确保完成的优先顺序排列立即措施。部分床旁操作可重叠进行，但排序应反映主要优先级。

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen by nasal cannula to support tissue oxygenation during the perfusion crisis.
options.zh: 经鼻导管给予氧气，以在灌注危机中支持组织氧合。

options.en: Reposition the client supine and start the ordered isotonic crystalloid bolus while reassessing perfusion and lung status.
options.zh: 协助患者平卧，并开始医嘱的等渗晶体液快速补液，同时复评灌注和肺部情况。

options.en: Redraw blood cultures from new sites before the antibiotic regimen is broadened.
options.zh: 在扩大抗生素方案前，从新部位重新采集血培养。

options.en: Activate the rapid response team and notify the oncologist with the BP drop, HR rise, urine-output decline, and lactate rise.
options.zh: 启动快速反应团队，并向肿瘤科医生报告血压下降、心率升高、尿量减少和乳酸升高。

correct.en: The Stage 2 findings show progression toward sepsis with hypotension, rising lactate, oliguria, tachycardia, and slower responses. Restoring perfusion and escalating the team come first; oxygen supports the oxygen-delivery problem, and repeat cultures should precede the antibiotic change without delaying resuscitation.
correct.zh: 第 2 阶段表现为向脓毒症进展：低血压、乳酸升高、少尿、心动过速和反应变慢。首先要恢复灌注并升级团队；氧气支持氧输送问题；重复培养应在调整抗生素前完成，但不能延误复苏。

byChoice.en: This is first because hypotension, rising lactate, delayed capillary refill, and falling urine output indicate inadequate perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 此项排第一，因为低血压、乳酸升高、再充盈延迟和尿量下降说明灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Team activation and oncology notification must follow immediately so broader antibiotics, possible vasopressors, and higher-level care are not delayed.
byChoice.zh: 随后必须立即启动团队并通知肿瘤科，以免延误扩大抗生素、可能的升压药和更高级别护理。

byChoice.en: Oxygen is appropriate because oxygen delivery is threatened, but it does not replace fluid resuscitation and escalation for the perfusion problem.
byChoice.zh: 给予氧气是合适的，因为氧输送受到威胁；但它不能替代针对灌注问题的补液复苏和升级处理。

byChoice.en: Repeat cultures are important before broadened antibiotics, but they should not delay the first perfusion-restoring actions during hemodynamic deterioration.
byChoice.zh: 扩大抗生素前重复培养很重要，但在血流动力学恶化时不能延误最先恢复灌注的措施。

testTakingStrategy.en: For deterioration with shock cues, prioritize perfusion restoration and team escalation before diagnostic tasks that can safely follow within minutes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到休克线索的病情恶化时，先恢复灌注并升级团队，再做可在几分钟内随后完成的诊断任务。

glossary.defZh: 组织灌注不足或氧利用异常时可升高的指标。
尿量减少，常提示肾灌注不足或容量/循环问题。
在患者急性恶化时提供紧急评估和升级处理的团队。
用于扩充血管内容量、改善灌注的静脉液体。

stem.en: Which nursing interventions are appropriate modifications for this severely neutropenic client? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 对于这名严重中性粒细胞减少患者，哪些护理措施属于适当调整？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Allow fresh flowers if the water is changed daily and the vase is kept away from the bed.
options.zh: 如果每天换水且花瓶远离床边，可以允许鲜花。

options.en: Follow the facility low-microbial/food-safety protocol for food brought to the client.
options.zh: 对患者食物遵循机构低微生物/食品安全方案。

options.en: Require hand hygiene before entry and restrict visitors who are ill.
options.zh: 进入病房前必须手卫生，并限制患病访客。

options.en: Minimize unnecessary invasive procedures and use meticulous aseptic technique for every PICC access.
options.zh: 尽量减少不必要的侵入性操作，每次使用 PICC 时严格无菌操作。

options.en: Use gentle oral care with a soft toothbrush and non-alcohol rinse for the mucositis site.
options.zh: 对口腔黏膜炎部位使用软毛牙刷和无酒精漱口液进行温和口腔护理。

options.en: Avoid rectal temperatures, rectal medications, enemas, and rectal assessment unless specifically ordered for an overriding reason.
options.zh: 避免直肠测温、直肠给药、灌肠和直肠评估，除非因更重要原因有明确医嘱。

correct.en: Severe neutropenia requires reducing microbial exposure and avoiding preventable mucosal or skin breaks. Rectal instrumentation is avoided, visitors and food are controlled by protocol, oral care should protect fragile mucosa, and all line access must be aseptic and necessary.
correct.zh: 严重中性粒细胞减少需要减少微生物暴露，并避免可预防的黏膜或皮肤破损。应避免直肠操作，按方案管理访客和食物，口腔护理要保护脆弱黏膜，所有管路操作都必须严格无菌且有必要。

byChoice.en: Food-safety precautions reduce exposure to organisms from unwashed, undercooked, unpasteurized, or unverifiable foods.
byChoice.zh: 食品安全措施可减少来自未清洗、未煮熟、未巴氏消毒或无法确认安全食物的病原体暴露。

byChoice.en: Hand hygiene and restricting ill visitors reduce exposure to organisms during the nadir.
byChoice.zh: 手卫生和限制患病访客可减少低谷期病原体暴露。

byChoice.en: Each avoidable skin or line breach can become a source of bloodstream infection in severe neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: 在严重中性粒细胞减少时，每一次可避免的皮肤或管路破口都可能成为血流感染来源。

byChoice.en: Gentle oral care prevents additional mucosal trauma while still reducing oral microbial burden.
byChoice.zh: 温和口腔护理既可减少口腔微生物负荷，又可避免进一步黏膜损伤。

byChoice.en: Fresh flowers and standing water are avoided because they can harbor organisms; moving them away from the bed does not remove the risk.
byChoice.zh: 应避免鲜花和积水，因为可能携带病原体；把它们远离床边并不能消除风险。

byChoice.en: Rectal instrumentation can injure colonized mucosa and introduce organisms the client cannot defend against.
byChoice.zh: 直肠操作可能损伤定植菌丰富的黏膜，并引入患者无法抵御的病原体。

testTakingStrategy.en: For neutropenia precautions, think: reduce exposure, protect mucosa, and avoid unnecessary breaks in skin or lines.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断中性粒细胞减少防护时，抓住三点：减少暴露、保护黏膜、避免不必要的皮肤或管路破口。

glossary.defZh: 为减少感染暴露而采取的手卫生、访客、饮食和环境控制措施。
化疗等因素导致的口腔或胃肠道黏膜炎症和脆弱。
防止病原体污染无菌部位、设备或管路的操作方法。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify how each finding should be used to evaluate the client's trajectory.
stem.zh: 在第 3 阶段，请判断每项发现应如何用于评估患者病情轨迹。

rows.en: Urine output improves from 15 mL/hr to 45-55 mL/hr
rows.zh: 尿量从 15 mL/hr 改善至 45-55 mL/hr

rows.en: Mental status improves from slower responses to alert and conversational
rows.zh: 精神状态从反应变慢改善为清醒并能交谈

rows.en: Preliminary Gram-positive organism is reported in the PICC lumen bottle
rows.zh: PICC 管腔培养瓶初步报告革兰阳性菌

correct.en: The overall trajectory is improving because perfusion and systemic response markers are reversing: lower temperature and heart rate, recovering blood pressure, better urine output, falling lactate, and improved alertness. The positive PICC-lumen culture is important and must be reported, but it does not erase the improving hemodynamic trend.
correct.zh: 总体轨迹在改善，因为灌注和全身反应指标正在逆转：体温和心率下降、血压恢复、尿量改善、乳酸下降、意识更清醒。PICC 管腔培养阳性很重要，必须报告，但不会否定血流动力学改善趋势。

byChoice.en: The temperature is still abnormal, but the downward trend after treatment supports improvement rather than ongoing worsening.
byChoice.zh: 体温仍异常，但治疗后下降趋势支持改善而非继续恶化。

byChoice.en: A falling heart rate shows reduced physiologic stress and supports response to treatment.
byChoice.zh: 心率下降说明生理应激减轻，支持治疗有反应。

byChoice.en: Recovering blood pressure suggests perfusion is improving after fluid resuscitation and therapy escalation.
byChoice.zh: 血压恢复提示补液复苏和治疗升级后灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Urine output is a direct perfusion marker; improvement from oliguria supports better renal perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿量是直接灌注指标；从少尿改善支持肾灌注变好。

byChoice.en: The lactate is not fully normal, but the downward trend suggests tissue perfusion is improving.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸尚未完全正常，但下降趋势提示组织灌注在改善。

byChoice.en: Improved alertness supports better cerebral perfusion and overall stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 意识改善支持脑灌注和总体稳定性变好。

byChoice.en: This result must be communicated because it may indicate catheter-related bloodstream infection and may change the plan once speciation returns.
byChoice.zh: 该结果必须沟通，因为可能提示导管相关血流感染，待菌种鉴定后可能改变治疗计划。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trending the same cues that signaled danger; one new lab result can require follow-up without overturning the whole trend.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估效果时，要追踪最初提示危险的同一组线索；一个新的化验结果可能需要跟进，但不一定推翻整体趋势。

glossary.defZh: 患者随时间表现出的改善、稳定或恶化方向。
血管内导管可能成为来源的血流感染。
血液向组织输送氧气和营养的过程。

stem.en: Which discharge-readiness teaching should the nurse give about seeking emergency care during future chemotherapy nadir periods? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 关于未来化疗低谷期何时需要急诊就医，护士应提供哪些出院准备教育？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Take acetaminophen or ibuprofen first, then call the clinic the next morning if the fever returns.
options.zh: 先服用对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬；如果发热复发，第二天早上再打电话给门诊。

options.en: Go for immediate evaluation for rigors, shaking chills, sudden lightheadedness, confusion, or rapid heartbeat even if a fever has not yet been confirmed.
options.zh: 即使尚未确认发热，若出现寒战、发抖、突然头晕、意识混乱或心跳很快，也应立即就医评估。

options.en: Use an oral thermometer for temperature checks and do not take rectal temperatures.
options.zh: 使用口温计测量体温，不要测直肠温。

options.en: If there are no localizing symptoms, wait unless the fever is above 102.2 °F (39 °C).
options.zh: 如果没有局部症状，除非体温超过 102.2 °F (39 °C)，否则可以等待。

options.en: Seek emergency care immediately for any single oral temperature of 101 °F (38.3 °C) or higher.
options.zh: 任何单次口温达到或超过 101 °F (38.3 °C)时，应立即急诊就医。

options.en: Seek emergency care for oral temperature of 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) or higher that persists for one hour, per oncology instructions.
options.zh: 按肿瘤科指导，口温达到或超过 100.4 °F (38.0 °C)并持续 1 小时时，应急诊就医。

correct.en: Teaching must be specific and action-oriented because fever during the nadir can be the only early sign of life-threatening infection. The client should use oral temperature thresholds from the oncology plan, avoid rectal measurements, avoid masking fever with antipyretics before evaluation, and seek care for systemic illness cues even before a temperature is confirmed.
correct.zh: 教育必须具体、以行动为导向，因为低谷期发热可能是危及生命感染的唯一早期征象。患者应使用肿瘤科计划中的口温阈值，避免直肠测温，评估前不要用退热药掩盖发热，并且即使尚未确认体温，出现全身不适线索也应就医。

byChoice.en: The sustained-temperature threshold also triggers emergency care when it persists for one hour.
byChoice.zh: 体温达到持续阈值并持续 1 小时时，也应急诊就医。

byChoice.en: Waiting for a higher fever or localizing symptoms is unsafe because neutropenic clients may lack local inflammatory signs.
byChoice.zh: 等待更高发热或局部症状不安全，因为中性粒细胞减少患者可能没有局部炎症体征。

byChoice.en: This is the single-reading fever threshold in the oncology instructions and should trigger emergency evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 这是肿瘤科指导中的单次读数发热阈值，应触发急诊评估。

byChoice.en: Rigors or sudden systemic symptoms can signal bacteremia or sepsis even before the client captures a temperature reading.
byChoice.zh: 寒战或突然全身症状可在患者测到体温前提示菌血症或脓毒症。

byChoice.en: Antipyretics can mask the fever and delay recognition and antibiotics; the client should seek guidance/evaluation before suppressing the fever.
byChoice.zh: 退热药会掩盖发热并延误识别和抗生素治疗；患者应在压低体温前寻求指导/评估。

byChoice.en: Oral measurement matches the plan; rectal temperatures can injure mucosa and introduce organisms during neutropenia.
byChoice.zh: 口温测量符合计划；直肠测温在中性粒细胞减少时可能损伤黏膜并引入病原体。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge teaching, convert the emergency into exact numbers and exact actions the client can follow at home.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院教育题时，要把急症转换成患者在家能执行的具体数字和具体行动。

glossary.defZh: 用于降低发热的药物，如对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬。
因可能危及生命而需要立即到急诊或指定急救地点接受评估。
患者可能觉得不严重的轻度发热，但在中性粒细胞减少时仍可很危险。

correct.en: This case centers on recognizing fever during chemotherapy nadir as a neutropenic emergency, preserving culture yield without delaying empiric antibiotics, preventing portals of entry, escalating promptly when perfusion worsens, and teaching exact home return precautions. Stage 2 shows progression toward neutropenic sepsis; Stage 3 shows improvement by reversing perfusion markers while still requiring inpatient antibiotics and follow-up of the positive PICC-lumen culture.
correct.zh: 本病例重点是识别化疗低谷期发热为中性粒细胞减少相关急症，在不延误经验性抗生素的前提下保留培养诊断价值，预防感染入口，灌注恶化时及时升级处理，并用具体标准进行居家返院教育。第 2 阶段显示向中性粒细胞减少性脓毒症进展；第 3 阶段通过灌注指标逆转显示改善，但仍需住院 IV 抗生素并跟进 PICC 管腔培养阳性结果。

testTakingStrategy.en: Follow the timeline: first recognize the emergency, then protect diagnostic cultures while starting treatment, then respond to shock cues, then evaluate trends and teach return precautions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 按时间线思考：先识别急症，再在开始治疗的同时保护培养诊断价值，然后应对休克线索，最后评估趋势并教育返院标准。

glossary.termZh: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
glossary.defZh: 中性粒细胞减少患者出现达到阈值的发热，需按急症处理。
化疗后血细胞计数最低、感染风险最高的时期。
感染引起的全身反应导致器官灌注或功能受损。

glossary.termZh: 经外周置入中心静脉导管
glossary.defZh: 用于长期静脉治疗的中心静脉通路，可成为感染来源。

parents.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Transfusion-associated circulatory overload versus transfusion-related acute lung injury in a client with chronic kidney disease
title.zh: 慢性肾病患者输血相关循环超负荷与输血相关急性肺损伤的鉴别

summary.en: A 74-year-old woman with chronic kidney disease stage 3b, compensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, type 2 diabetes, and symptomatic anemia is admitted for packed red blood cell transfusion. Two units are ordered sequentially. Facility protocol requires bedside verification by two RNs, vital-sign monitoring during transfusion, and provider-directed IV furosemide between units if signs of fluid overload occur.
summary.zh: 一名74岁女性因症状性贫血入院，既往有3b期慢性肾病、代偿期射血分数保留型心力衰竭和2型糖尿病。医嘱连续输注2单位浓缩红细胞。机构流程要求两名注册护士床旁核对、输血期间监测生命体征；若出现液体负荷过重表现，由医嘱给予单位间IV呋塞米。

content.en:
History: chronic kidney disease stage 3b with baseline eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m2; compensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, EF 52%, grade I diastolic dysfunction; type 2 diabetes. Home medications include furosemide 40 mg daily, lisinopril 10 mg daily, metformin 500 mg twice daily, and insulin glargine 18 units at bedtime.

Reason for admission: progressive fatigue, exertional dyspnea on one flight of stairs, lightheadedness, outpatient hemoglobin 6.4 g/dL. No prior transfusion reactions.

Orders/protocol: two units packed red blood cells sequentially; each unit over 2 hours, not to exceed 4 hours per unit. Vital signs at baseline, 15 minutes after initiation, every 30 minutes during infusion, and at completion. Furosemide 20 mg IV between units if signs of fluid overload occur. Blood product verification by two RNs: client identity, ABO/Rh, unit number, crossmatch information, and expiration date.
content.zh:
病史：3b期慢性肾病，基线eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m2；代偿期射血分数保留型心力衰竭，EF 52%，I级舒张功能障碍；2型糖尿病。居家用药包括呋塞米40 mg每日一次、赖诺普利10 mg每日一次、二甲双胍500 mg每日两次、甘精胰岛素睡前18单位。

入院原因：进行性疲乏、上一层楼即活动后气短、头晕，门诊血红蛋白6.4 g/dL。无既往输血反应史。

医嘱/流程：连续输注2单位浓缩红细胞；每单位输注2小时，单单位不得超过4小时。生命体征在基线、开始后15分钟、输注期间每30分钟和输注结束时测量。若出现液体负荷过重表现，单位间给予呋塞米20 mg IV。由两名RN核对血制品：患者身份、ABO/Rh、单位号、交叉配血信息和有效期。

title.zh: 输血前评估和实验室资料

content.en:
At start of transfusion: resting comfortably at 30 degrees; tired but denies chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or new symptoms. Alert, oriented, conversational, no acute distress.

Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 92, BP 138/82, RR 16, SpO2 96% on room air. Weight 78 kg, near outpatient dry weight 77 kg. Lungs clear bilaterally with faint bibasilar crackles reported as chronic and unchanged. Regular S1/S2, no S3 or S4. No JVD at 45 degrees. Trace bilateral ankle edema at baseline. Skin warm, dry, pale. Capillary refill 3 seconds. No rash, urticaria, or pruritus. Abdomen soft, non-distended. Urine output: 200 mL clear yellow urine in past 4 hours.

Labs: Hgb 6.4 g/dL, Hct 19.2%, WBC 7.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL. BUN 34 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m2. K 4.6 mEq/L, Na 139 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L, CO2 22 mEq/L. BNP 280 pg/mL. Albumin 3.0 g/dL. Blood type A-positive, antibody screen negative, crossmatch compatible.
content.zh:
输血开始时：患者以床头抬高30度休息，感觉疲乏，但否认胸痛、静息时气短或新症状。神志清楚，能交谈，无急性痛苦表现。

生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92，BP 138/82，RR 16，室内空气SpO2 96%。体重78 kg，接近门诊干体重77 kg。双肺清，双侧肺底有轻微湿啰音，患者称为慢性且无变化。心律规则，S1/S2存在，无S3或S4。床头45度时无颈静脉怒张。双踝基线为轻度凹陷性水肿。皮肤温暖、干燥、苍白。毛细血管再充盈3秒。无皮疹、荨麻疹或瘙痒。腹软、无膨隆。尿量：过去4小时清黄色尿200 mL。

实验室：Hgb 6.4 g/dL，Hct 19.2%，WBC 7.2 ×10³/µL，血小板188 ×10³/µL。BUN 34 mg/dL，肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m2。K 4.6 mEq/L，Na 139 mEq/L，Cl 102 mEq/L，CO2 22 mEq/L。BNP 280 pg/mL。白蛋白3.0 g/dL。血型A阳性，抗体筛查阴性，交叉配血相合。

title.en: Stage 1: first unit, 15 minutes through completion
title.zh: 阶段1：第一单位，15分钟至输注结束

content.en: Fifteen-minute vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 90, BP 140/84, RR 16, SpO2 96%. No complaints. First unit infuses over 2 hours without incident. End-of-unit vital signs: T 37.1 C, HR 88, BP 142/86, RR 18, SpO2 96%. The client feels slightly less fatigued. Lung sounds remain clear with the same faint bibasilar crackles. No JVD, no change in edema. Urine output during the 2-hour infusion: 90 mL. The provider is updated. Furosemide between units is not triggered because there is no new dyspnea, edema, JVD, or desaturation. The second unit is verified by two RNs and initiated.
content.zh: 15分钟生命体征：T 36.9 C，HR 90，BP 140/84，RR 16，SpO2 96%。无不适。第一单位在2小时内顺利输完。单位结束生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 88，BP 142/86，RR 18，SpO2 96%。患者感觉疲乏稍有减轻。肺音仍清，仅有原有轻微双肺底湿啰音。无颈静脉怒张，水肿无变化。2小时输注期间尿量90 mL。已更新告知医嘱者。因无新发气短、水肿、颈静脉怒张或氧饱和度下降，单位间呋塞米未触发。第二单位由两名RN核对后开始输注。

title.en: Stage 2: second unit, 45 minutes into transfusion
title.zh: 阶段2：第二单位，输注45分钟
第二单位输注期间急性变化

content.en: The client uses the call light and reports shortness of breath and that she cannot get comfortable. She is sitting upright, gripping the side rails. Vital signs: T 37.2 C, HR 110, BP 168/96, RR 28, SpO2 89% on room air. New bilateral crackles extend from the bases to the mid-lung fields, markedly different from baseline. A new S3 gallop is audible. JVD is visible at 45 degrees. Lower-extremity edema has increased to 2+ bilateral pitting. Face is flushed, but there is no urticaria, hives, angioedema, or wheezing. She denies itching, throat tightness, and abdominal cramping. She has a new nonproductive cough. Urine output over the past 45 minutes is 15 mL. She says, 'I feel like I am drowning.'
content.zh: 患者按铃，诉气短并表示怎么都不舒服。她坐直，抓着床栏。生命体征：T 37.2 C，HR 110，BP 168/96，RR 28，室内空气SpO2 89%。新出现双侧湿啰音，从肺底延伸至中肺野，与基线明显不同。可闻及新的S3奔马律。床头45度时可见颈静脉怒张。下肢水肿增至双侧2+凹陷性水肿。面部潮红，但无荨麻疹、风团、血管性水肿或喘鸣。否认瘙痒、喉咙发紧和腹部绞痛。新出现干咳。过去45分钟尿量15 mL。患者说：“我感觉像要被淹死。”

title.en: Stage 3: 30 minutes after stopping transfusion and initial interventions
title.zh: 阶段3：停止输血并初步处理后30分钟

content.en:
The transfusion was stopped immediately. The IV line was kept patent with normal saline using new tubing at a keep-vein-open rate. The client was placed in high Fowler's position. Oxygen was applied by non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min. The provider was notified and arrived at the bedside. Furosemide 40 mg IV was administered by stat order. The blood bank was notified; the remaining blood bag and old tubing were sent with a post-transfusion blood sample and urine sample per protocol.

Thirty minutes later: T 37.1 C, HR 98, BP 152/88, RR 22, SpO2 94% on non-rebreather. The client reports feeling a little better and less like drowning. Crackles are still present at the bases and lower-mid fields but have receded. JVD is less prominent. Urine output since furosemide: 180 mL clear yellow urine. S3 remains but is softer. Edema remains 2+ and is not worsening.
content.zh:
立即停止输血。更换新输液管，以生理盐水维持静脉通路通畅，速度为KVO。患者取高Fowler体位。给予非再呼吸面罩15 L/min吸氧。通知医嘱者，医嘱者到床旁。按立即医嘱给予呋塞米40 mg IV。通知血库；按流程将剩余血袋、旧输血管、输血后血样和尿样送检。

30分钟后：T 37.1 C，HR 98，BP 152/88，RR 22，非再呼吸面罩下SpO2 94%。患者表示稍好一些，不再那么像被淹死。肺底和中下肺野仍有湿啰音，但范围已缩小。颈静脉怒张减轻。呋塞米后尿量：清黄色尿180 mL。S3仍可闻及但较轻。水肿仍为2+，未继续加重。

content.en: Portable chest X-ray: bilateral pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral pleural effusions, cardiomegaly, and widened vascular pedicle, consistent with hydrostatic pulmonary edema. No bilateral patchy infiltrates characteristic of non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema are seen. BNP: 890 pg/mL, up from 280 pg/mL baseline. Post-transfusion hemoglobin: 8.1 g/dL.
content.zh: 床旁胸片：双肺肺血管淤血、双侧少量胸腔积液、心影增大、血管蒂增宽，符合静水压性肺水肿。未见非心源性肺水肿常见的双侧斑片状浸润。BNP 890 pg/mL，较基线280 pg/mL升高。输血后血红蛋白8.1 g/dL。

content.en: A second dose of furosemide 20 mg IV was given 2 hours after the first dose for continued but improving fluid overload. Current vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 84, BP 136/78, RR 18, SpO2 96% on 4 L nasal cannula after weaning from the non-rebreather. The client is resting comfortably at 45 degrees and says she can breathe much more easily. Lung sounds have returned to faint bibasilar crackles only, similar to admission baseline. JVD is no longer visible. Edema has returned to trace bilaterally. S3 is no longer audible. Total urine output since the initial furosemide dose: 1,400 mL over 4 hours. Repeat BNP: 420 pg/mL. Provider documentation: transfusion-associated circulatory overload; hold remaining packed red blood cells pending reassessment; repeat hemoglobin in 6 hours; consult nephrology for future transfusion planning such as slower rate, pre-transfusion diuretic, and single-unit strategy. Transfusion reaction report completed per policy.
content.zh: 因液体超负荷仍存在但正在改善，在首次呋塞米后2小时给予第二剂呋塞米20 mg IV。当前生命体征：T 36.9 C，HR 84，BP 136/78，RR 18；已从非再呼吸面罩降至鼻导管4 L，SpO2 96%。患者以床头45度安静休息，表示呼吸轻松很多。肺音恢复为仅有轻微双肺底湿啰音，类似入院基线。颈静脉怒张消失。双侧水肿恢复至轻度。S3不再可闻及。首次呋塞米后4小时总尿量1,400 mL。复查BNP 420 pg/mL。医嘱者记录为输血相关循环超负荷；暂停剩余浓缩红细胞，待重新评估；6小时后复查血红蛋白；请肾内科会诊规划后续输血，如更慢速度、输血前利尿剂和单单位策略。已按政策完成输血反应报告。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Use the Stage 2 findings to identify the most likely transfusion reaction and the strongest differentiating cue cluster.
stem.zh: 根据阶段2表现判断最可能的输血反应及最能鉴别的线索组合。

clozeStem.en: The most likely reaction is {{reaction}} because the client has {{evidence}} during the transfusion.
clozeStem.zh: 最可能的反应是 {{reaction}}，因为患者在输血期间出现 {{evidence}}。

options.en: anaphylactic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 过敏性休克型输血反应

options.en: transfusion-associated circulatory overload
options.zh: 输血相关循环超负荷

options.en: transfusion-related acute lung injury
options.zh: 输血相关急性肺损伤

options.en: febrile non-hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 发热性非溶血性输血反应

options.en: angioedema, wheezing, urticaria, hypotension, and throat tightness
options.zh: 血管性水肿、喘鸣、荨麻疹、低血压和喉咙发紧

options.en: hypertension with JVD, new S3, worsening edema, pulmonary crackles, oliguria, and high-risk cardiac/renal history
options.zh: 高血压伴颈静脉怒张、新S3、水肿加重、肺部湿啰音、少尿，以及心肾高危病史

options.en: hypoxemia with bilateral infiltrates but no evidence of circulatory overload
options.zh: 低氧并伴双侧浸润，但无循环超负荷证据

options.en: fever and chills without respiratory compromise
options.zh: 发热和寒战，但无呼吸受损

correct.en: The client has acute respiratory distress during transfusion, but the differentiating pattern is circulatory overload: hypertension, JVD, S3, worsening edema, decreased urine output, crackles, older age, CKD, heart failure history, and low albumin. TRALI remains a competing respiratory transfusion reaction, but the presence of multiple volume-overload signs points away from isolated noncardiogenic lung injury.
correct.zh: 患者在输血期间出现急性呼吸困难，但最能鉴别的是循环超负荷模式：高血压、颈静脉怒张、S3、水肿加重、尿量减少、湿啰音、高龄、慢性肾病、心衰病史和低白蛋白。TRALI也是呼吸性输血反应的鉴别诊断，但多项容量超负荷体征使单纯非心源性肺损伤的可能性降低。

byChoice.en: The reaction dropdown should be TACO because the case clusters acute dyspnea with volume-overload findings rather than fever, isolated allergy, or isolated noncardiogenic lung injury.
byChoice.zh: 反应下拉框应选择TACO，因为病例把急性气短与容量超负荷表现组合在一起，而不是发热、单纯过敏或单纯非心源性肺损伤。

byChoice.en: The evidence dropdown should identify the overload cluster: hypertension, elevated venous/filling-pressure findings, peripheral edema, pulmonary congestion, oliguria, and cardiac/renal risk factors.
byChoice.zh: 证据下拉框应识别超负荷组合：高血压、静脉/充盈压升高表现、外周水肿、肺淤血、少尿以及心肾危险因素。

testTakingStrategy.en: When two transfusion reactions both cause dyspnea, look for the mechanism: volume-overload signs favor TACO; absence of circulatory overload with bilateral infiltrates favors TRALI.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当两种输血反应都可导致气短时，要寻找机制：容量超负荷体征支持TACO；无循环超负荷而有双侧浸润更支持TRALI。

glossary.defZh: 由血管内压力或容量负荷过高导致液体进入肺间质/肺泡。
不是由心脏充盈压升高引起的肺水肿，如TRALI相关肺损伤。
以发热、寒战为主的输血反应，通常不是以容量超负荷为主。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 2, which problem requires the nurse's most immediate response?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，哪一个问题最需要护士立即处理？

options.en: Decreased urine output during the second unit
options.zh: 第二单位输注期间尿量减少

options.en: Hypertension of 168/96 mm Hg
options.zh: 血压168/96 mm Hg

options.en: Acute hypoxemia with respiratory distress
options.zh: 急性低氧伴呼吸窘迫

options.en: Ongoing symptomatic anemia after only partial transfusion
options.zh: 仅部分输血后仍有症状性贫血

correct.en: The immediate threat is impaired oxygenation: SpO2 89%, RR 28, acute dyspnea, and the client's feeling of drowning. The hypertension, oliguria, and anemia matter, but oxygenation and breathing take priority while the transfusion is stopped and volume overload is treated.
correct.zh: 最直接的威胁是氧合受损：SpO2 89%、RR 28、突发气短，以及患者感觉像被淹死。高血压、少尿和贫血都重要，但在停止输血并处理容量超负荷时，氧合和呼吸优先。

byChoice.en: Low urine output supports fluid-overload physiology and will guide diuretic response, but it is not the first immediate threat.
byChoice.zh: 尿量低支持液体超负荷的生理机制，并可用于观察利尿反应，但不是首先的即时威胁。

byChoice.en: Hypertension supports the overload mechanism, but it is not more urgent than active hypoxemia and respiratory distress.
byChoice.zh: 高血压支持超负荷机制，但其紧急性不高于正在发生的低氧和呼吸窘迫。

byChoice.en: Correct. Hypoxemia with respiratory distress is an immediate ABC threat and must be addressed first.
byChoice.zh: 正确。低氧伴呼吸窘迫是立即的ABC威胁，必须首先处理。

byChoice.en: Anemia is the reason for transfusion, but continuing transfusion during a reaction would be unsafe; respiratory compromise now takes priority.
byChoice.zh: 贫血是输血原因，但发生反应时继续输血不安全；当前应优先处理呼吸受损。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use ABCs for acute deterioration. Treat the cause, but first stabilize breathing and oxygenation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到急性恶化时使用ABC原则。要处理病因，但首先稳定呼吸和氧合。

glossary.defZh: 血液氧含量或氧饱和度低，可能迅速进展为呼吸衰竭。
优先评估和处理气道、呼吸、循环。
呼吸费力、呼吸频率增快或主观气短等提示通气/氧合受损的表现。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Which actions belong in the management plan for this suspected TACO episode? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 针对这次疑似TACO，哪些措施应纳入处理计划？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Notify the provider, anticipate ordered IV furosemide, and monitor intake and output closely.
options.zh: 通知医嘱者，预期按医嘱给予IV呋塞米，并密切监测出入量。

options.en: Stop the transfusion and keep the IV line patent with normal saline using new tubing at a keep-vein-open rate.
options.zh: 停止输血，并用新管路以生理盐水KVO维持静脉通路通畅。

options.en: Place the client in high Fowler's position.
options.zh: 协助患者取高Fowler体位。

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen and monitor pulse oximetry.
options.zh: 给予补充氧并监测脉搏氧饱和度。

options.en: Restart the unit at a slower rate once the SpO2 begins to improve.
options.zh: 一旦SpO2开始改善，就以更慢速度重新开始该单位输血。

options.en: Administer a rapid IV fluid bolus to support circulation.
options.zh: 快速给予IV快速补液 以支持循环。

correct.en: TACO management begins with stopping the transfusion, maintaining IV access with new tubing, positioning upright, supporting oxygenation, notifying the provider, and using ordered diuresis with close intake/output monitoring. Restarting the transfusion or giving a fluid bolus would worsen the volume problem.
correct.zh: TACO处理首先包括停止输血、用新管路维持静脉通路、取坐位、支持氧合、通知医嘱者，并按医嘱利尿且密切监测出入量。重新输血或快速补液会加重容量问题。

byChoice.en: Correct. High Fowler's position reduces preload and improves chest expansion and breathing mechanics.
byChoice.zh: 正确。高Fowler体位有助于降低前负荷，并改善胸廓扩张和呼吸力学。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. A transfusion reaction with respiratory compromise requires stopping the transfusion, not slowing or restarting it during the reaction.
byChoice.zh: 错误。伴呼吸受损的输血反应需要停止输血，不能在反应期间减慢或重新开始。

byChoice.en: Correct. Diuresis treats hydrostatic overload in TACO when ordered, and urine output confirms response.
byChoice.zh: 正确。按医嘱利尿可处理TACO的静水压性超负荷，尿量可确认反应。

byChoice.en: Correct. The client is hypoxemic, so oxygen and close SpO2 monitoring are immediate priorities.
byChoice.zh: 正确。患者低氧，因此吸氧和密切监测SpO2是立即优先事项。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The client is hypertensive and volume overloaded; additional IV fluid would worsen pulmonary congestion.
byChoice.zh: 错误。患者高血压且容量超负荷，额外IV补液会加重肺淤血。

byChoice.en: Correct. The transfusion must be stopped; new tubing with normal saline maintains access without infusing more blood through the reaction tubing.
byChoice.zh: 正确。必须停止输血；用新管路和生理盐水维持通路，避免继续通过反应相关输血管路输入血液。

testTakingStrategy.en: Match treatment to mechanism. TACO is hydrostatic volume overload, so oxygenation support and ordered diuresis fit; fluids and restarting the transfusion do not.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理措施要匹配机制。TACO是静水压性容量超负荷，因此支持氧合和按医嘱利尿合适；补液和重新输血不合适。

glossary.defZh: 以最低速度维持静脉通路通畅的输液方式。
袢利尿剂，可促进排尿以减少容量负荷。
心脏舒张末期充盈量或容量负荷。

stem.en: At Stage 2, classify each action as part of the first-priority concurrent RN response or as a next/protocol step after immediate stabilization begins.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，请将每项措施分类为护士第一优先、可同时进行的立即反应，或为即时稳定开始后的后续/流程步骤。

rows.en: Position the client in high Fowler's.
Apply high-flow oxygen for SpO2 89% with dyspnea.
rows.zh: 因SpO2 89%且气短，给予高流量氧。

rows.en: Notify the provider for assessment and diuretic orders.
rows.zh: 通知医嘱者进行评估并开具利尿剂医嘱。

rows.en: Notify the blood bank and send the blood product, tubing, and ordered samples per protocol.
rows.zh: 通知血库，并按流程送回血制品、管路和规定样本。

columns.zh: 第一优先、同时进行的反应

correct.en: The first-priority concurrent RN actions are stopping the transfusion, placing the client upright, and applying oxygen because they require no new order and directly address ongoing exposure and hypoxemia. Provider notification, blood bank notification/sample handling, and reaction reporting are essential, but they do not replace immediate stabilization.
correct.zh: 护士第一优先、可同时进行的措施是停止输血、让患者坐起和给氧，因为这些不需要新医嘱，并直接处理持续暴露和低氧。通知医嘱者、通知血库/处理样本和填写反应报告都很重要，但不能取代立即稳定患者。

byChoice.en: Stopping the transfusion removes the ongoing source of added intravascular volume and is an immediate RN action.
byChoice.zh: 停止输血可移除继续增加血管内容量的来源，是RN可立即执行的措施。

byChoice.en: High Fowler's can be done immediately and helps ventilation and venous return in acute pulmonary congestion.
byChoice.zh: 高Fowler体位可立即执行，有助于急性肺淤血时改善通气并减少静脉回流负荷。

byChoice.en: Oxygen directly addresses SpO2 89% and acute dyspnea, so it belongs in the first response set.
byChoice.zh: 给氧直接处理SpO2 89%和突发气短，因此属于第一反应组合。

byChoice.en: Provider notification is urgent and enables ordered therapy, but the nurse should not delay stopping, positioning, or oxygenating to make the call first.
byChoice.zh: 通知医嘱者很紧急，并可启动医嘱治疗，但护士不应为先打电话而延迟停止输血、摆体位或给氧。

byChoice.en: Blood bank notification and sample handling are required for reaction investigation, but they follow immediate stabilization actions.
byChoice.zh: 通知血库和处理样本是反应调查所需，但应在立即稳定措施之后进行。

byChoice.en: Documentation is required but is lower priority than stopping the reaction exposure and correcting hypoxemia.
byChoice.zh: 文书记录是必需的，但优先级低于停止反应暴露和纠正低氧。

testTakingStrategy.en: When steps are simultaneous, avoid forcing a rigid order. Identify which actions are independent, immediate, and harm-reducing, then separate protocol work that can follow.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当措施几乎同时进行时，不要强行排序。先找出独立、立即、能减少伤害的措施，再区分可随后完成的流程性工作。

glossary.defZh: 记录和上报疑似输血不良反应的机构文件/流程。
向输血服务部门报告疑似反应，以便调查血制品和患者样本。
在急症中几乎同时执行的一组优先护理操作。

stem.en: Which Stage 3 and Stage 4 findings best show that the TACO episode is resolving? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段3和阶段4哪些发现最能说明TACO正在缓解？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Post-transfusion hemoglobin is 8.1 g/dL.
options.zh: 输血后血红蛋白为8.1 g/dL。

options.en: RR, HR, and BP trend back toward baseline.
options.zh: RR、HR和BP向基线回归。

options.en: BNP trends down from 890 pg/mL to 420 pg/mL after treatment.
options.zh: 治疗后BNP从890 pg/mL下降至420 pg/mL。

options.en: JVD resolves, S3 is no longer audible, edema returns to trace, and lung sounds return to baseline.
options.zh: 颈静脉怒张消失、S3不再可闻及、水肿恢复至轻度、肺音回到基线。

options.en: SpO2 improves from 89% to 96% while oxygen is weaned from non-rebreather to nasal cannula.
options.zh: SpO2从89%改善至96%，同时氧疗从非再呼吸面罩降至鼻导管。

options.en: Urine output reaches 1,400 mL over 4 hours after furosemide.
options.zh: 呋塞米后4小时尿量达到1,400 mL。

correct.en: Resolution of TACO is shown by improving oxygenation with oxygen weaning, normalized respiratory and hemodynamic trends, brisk diuresis after furosemide, disappearance of congestion findings, and a falling BNP trend. Hemoglobin shows transfusion effect, not resolution of pulmonary congestion.
correct.zh: TACO缓解表现为氧合改善并能降阶氧疗、呼吸和血流动力学趋势恢复、呋塞米后明显利尿、淤血体征消退，以及BNP下降趋势。血红蛋白反映输血效果，而不是肺淤血是否缓解。

byChoice.en: Correct. BNP is supportive when interpreted with the whole clinical picture; the downward trend is consistent with improving cardiac stretch/volume load.
byChoice.zh: 正确。BNP需要结合整体临床情况解读；下降趋势符合心脏牵张/容量负荷改善。

byChoice.en: Correct. RR, HR, and BP returning toward baseline show reduced acute distress and less overload physiology.
byChoice.zh: 正确。RR、HR和BP回归基线说明急性应激减轻，超负荷生理状态改善。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Hemoglobin shows red cell transfusion efficacy, not whether hydrostatic pulmonary edema has resolved.
byChoice.zh: 错误。血红蛋白显示红细胞输注效果，不说明静水压性肺水肿是否缓解。

byChoice.en: Correct. Brisk urine output after furosemide confirms removal of excess volume, the mechanism needed for TACO resolution.
byChoice.zh: 正确。呋塞米后尿量明显增加，确认多余容量正在排出，这是TACO缓解所需机制。

byChoice.en: Correct. Resolution of JVD, S3, edema, and crackles shows the physical signs of congestion are reversing.
byChoice.zh: 正确。颈静脉怒张、S3、水肿和湿啰音消退，说明淤血体征正在逆转。

byChoice.en: Correct. Stable saturation while oxygen support is reduced is stronger evidence of true respiratory improvement than SpO2 alone on high-flow oxygen.
byChoice.zh: 正确。在降低氧支持的同时氧饱和度仍稳定，比单纯在高流量氧下SpO2正常更能说明呼吸真正改善。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate the outcome that matches the problem. For overload, look for removal of volume and reversal of congestion, not just a successful hemoglobin rise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果要对应问题。对于容量超负荷，要看容量排出和淤血逆转，而不只是血红蛋白上升。

glossary.defZh: 在患者能维持氧合时逐步降低氧流量或氧疗装置强度。
给予利尿剂后尿量增加，提示多余液体被排出。
胸片中心脏影像增大，可支持心源性/容量相关问题。

correct.en: The case shows an acute respiratory transfusion reaction during the second unit of packed red blood cells. The new cue cluster is not simply chronic crackles: it includes abrupt dyspnea, hypoxemia, tachypnea, hypertension, new S3, JVD, worsening peripheral edema, oliguria, pulmonary vascular congestion, cardiomegaly, BNP rise, and rapid improvement with diuresis. Those findings support transfusion-associated circulatory overload rather than TRALI, allergic reaction, anaphylaxis, or a febrile non-hemolytic reaction. The safe nursing arc is to stop the transfusion, support oxygenation and positioning, notify the provider and blood bank, preserve the line with new tubing, administer ordered diuretic therapy for TACO, and evaluate improvement by oxygen weaning, vital-sign trends, urine output, and resolution of congestion.
correct.zh: 本病例显示患者在第二单位浓缩红细胞输注期间发生急性呼吸性输血反应。新的线索并不只是慢性肺底湿啰音，而是包括突发气短、低氧、呼吸急促、高血压、新S3、颈静脉怒张、外周水肿加重、少尿、肺血管淤血、心影增大、BNP升高，以及利尿后迅速改善。这些表现支持输血相关循环超负荷，而不是TRALI、过敏反应、过敏性休克或发热性非溶血性输血反应。安全的护理思路是立即停止输血，改善氧合和体位，通知医嘱者和血库，用新管路维持静脉通路，针对TACO给予医嘱利尿治疗，并通过氧气降阶、生命体征趋势、尿量和淤血体征消退来评价疗效。

testTakingStrategy.en: In transfusion reactions, first compare current findings with baseline, then separate respiratory distress caused by volume overload from noncardiogenic lung injury or allergy. Management follows the identified mechanism.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理输血反应题时，先把当前表现与基线比较，再区分由容量超负荷导致的呼吸困难、非心源性肺损伤和过敏反应。处理措施要跟随病理机制。

glossary.defZh: 输血后发生的容量/循环负荷过重，可导致静水压性肺水肿、低氧和淤血体征。
输血期间或输血后短时间内出现的急性非心源性肺损伤，通常没有循环超负荷证据。
颈静脉充盈明显，可提示中心静脉压升高或容量负荷过重。
心室压力或容量负荷增加时可升高的心脏相关标志物；需结合临床判断。
床头高抬的坐位，有助于胸廓扩张和改善呼吸。
